title: Completeness of the integral tensor unit
statement: For every scheme Y in the fixed prime and coefficient setting, the monoidal tensor unit of the integral coefficient calculus on Y is derived complete.

proof.text: The already proved private tensorUnit_complete in Sheaf.SixFunctors.OpenReconstructionEffectivity identifies the integral monoidal tensor unit with the native derived tensor unit using RingedKFlatModel.comparison_exists and the two unitors. RingedDerivedNative.unitIso and singleFunctorIsoCompQ identify the latter with integralConstantCoefficientObject, the completed regular coefficient module in degree zero.

The same helper applies integralConstantCoefficient_constructible to an auxiliary finite-field datum of characteristic different from l, and transports its unrestricted completeness assertion across the unit isomorphism using the Roos triangle. Reuse that completed helper by a proof-only import all. The global branch of IntegralOnSlice.IsComplete is definitionally IsDerivedCompleteUnrestricted, so the helper applies directly for every Y. The dependency recorded here is the constant-object completeness theorem used by the helper, not the unrelated public open-reconstruction theorem in its host module.

proof_origin.place: Private tensorUnit_complete and complete_of_iso; B7 reuses the existing proof without introducing a new obligation.
